aria: Our work: each project with its real status

steps.label: Our work
steps.title: Work we have done, [and what changed.]
steps.text: Each project shows its **real status**: finished, in progress or our own product.

steps.label: 01 · Omek Storefront
steps.title: Rebuilt to be [fast and clear.]
steps.text: The old shop was slow. Visitors left within a second. The design let the products down, and there was no clear call to action.

cards.label: Also fixed
cards.note: Found on the old site. All fixed.

cards.label: What we did
cards.note: We rebuilt the shop to load fast on a phone, with a clean design and a clear path to buy. All of these problems are fixed.

cards.label: Results
cards.note: Google PageSpeed phone test · 6 Jul to 18 Sep 2026

steps.label: 02 · SAN Collection
steps.title: Handcrafted bags, [a calm storefront.]
steps.text: Nothing gets in the way of the products. The shop is still being built.

cards.label: What we did
cards.note: A calm storefront for handcrafted bags, with nothing in the way of the products.

cards.label: Measured result
cards.note: Not measured yet. The shop is still being built, so there is no number to show.

steps.label: 03 · QuadERP
steps.title: 100/100 [for SEO.]
steps.text: Our store software. It tracks sales, stock across branches, staff theft and who owes what. Its website scores 100/100 for SEO and best practices.

cards.label: What we built
cards.note: Store management software that tracks sales, stock across branches, staff theft and who owes what.

cards.label: Measured result
cards.note: For SEO and for best practices, on the QuadERP website

steps.label: 04 · AI automation
steps.title: First reply [in 64 seconds.]
steps.text: Our WhatsApp assistant. First reply to a new enquiry: 64 seconds, day or night. The chat on the phone is a sample conversation.

cards.label: Measured result
cards.note: First reply, timed on a new enquiry

steps.label: 05 · AI video
steps.title: Films and reels, [no shoot day.]
steps.text: Fashion reels, story films and our own ad campaign. No shoot day.

cards.label: What we make
cards.note: Fresh videos every week keep you in front of buyers, with no shoot day.

steps.label: 06 · Fieldwork
steps.title: 40 checked leads [in two weeks.]
steps.text: Each with a contact and a reason to call. A real list we delivered. The client's name is withheld and the details are masked.

cards.label: What we did
cards.note: Found businesses that fit the client's ideal customer, checked each contact and gave a reason to call.

cards.label: Measured result
cards.note: Checked and delivered in two weeks

steps.label: Your turn
steps.title: Start with a [free check-up.]
steps.text: We check your website's speed, how it works on phones and how you show up on Google, then send you a short list of what to fix first.
